method_specification.name: Adaptive v1 corrected
method_specification.formula: S_corr = C * M_q; no available group -> 0
method_specification.quality: q_i = I_i * r_i; r is inherited manual reliability, not empirically established accuracy
method_specification.coverage: Sum of available raw-group budgets; title OR derived identifier uses one title-group budget

informativeness.fit_policy: TRAIN fit portion only; refit inside every development training fold

method_specification.threshold_policy: Threshold is external; select only on permitted inner development predictions

provenance.code_hash_policy: LF-normalized SHA-256 for cross-device CRLF compatibility; raw hashes also recorded

policy.source: Nine INNER held-out prediction sets only, never outer predictions
policy.duplicates: Mean raw inner held-out score per original pair_id; one equally weighted row per pair
policy.role: Final calibration, not independent performance estimation

logistic.missing_encoding: NaN -> similarity 0 and availability 0; observed zero -> availability 1

test_evaluation.status: NOT RUN; separate user authorization required
